learn_source: Watch the baker divide the feast batch at the counter in the Town scene — a whole town served alike, with no scale big enough and no argument over who got more
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on a divisible mass once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the measures match to a hair; at baseline they are near-even and a sharp eye can pick the big one. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: Parts cleanly into equal loaf-measures, each the match of the next
Parts into even wedges without tearing the crumb
State-dependent: full, it measures out into even servings; near-empty, it still parts even — into portions too small to serve anyone
no_effect — too little here to divide into anything
No physical effect — nothing living is parted
receivers.reaction_kind: wing-flap and scatter, regroups at the far fence
hums, picks up the finished measures and starts handing them along
